Maya (People Ops): Afternoon all-hands folks 11 1  quick live Q&A for comp/reviews/promos for 30 minutes. Promo window reminder: opens 2026-09-01. Links: https://intranet.redwood/promo-guide

Ibrahim (Eng): If a promo is approved but the comp band is ambiguous, do managers wait for comp letter or can they tell the person the level first?

Maya (People Ops): Tell level only. Use this phrasing: 'Promotion approved; compensation details forthcoming by <date>.' Avoid specific numbers until comp letters are sent.

Lena (Manager): Calibration logistics: can teams submit late evidence if we discover new info after deadline?

Maya (People Ops): We allow a 24-hr grace window for material evidence with manager sign-off. Anything beyond that has to go through appeals. Include timestamps on added docs.

Tom (Finance): Note: merit pool timing shifted slightly; bonuses tied to the cycle will be paid on 2026-10-01 payroll. Please flag any retroactive pay cases by 2026-09-20.

oncall-bot: Reminder: Calibration office hours today 4pm PT -> https://calendar.redwood/calibration

Ibrahim (Eng): Is there guidance for IC->staff promotions? What weight do cross-org impact and external recognition carry?

Maya (People Ops): Staff promotions need clear cross-org impact, stakeholder endorsements, and a compelling roadmap influence example. External awards help but are not required. Well post an example packet in the promo-guide doc.

Lena (Manager): Can managers request equity top-ups tied to promotion this cycle?

Tom (Finance): Short answer: limited pool this quarter. Use the 'equity-critical' flag on the submission; Finance will review high-priority cases.

Maya (People Ops): Thanks everyone  Ill summarize and post a short FAQ after this thread. DM if you need a 1:1.
